title: A Codex test's still-running record has no release when its end is lost while its runtime lives: Stop is the only way out
outcome: When a still-running Codex test's end is lost while its runtime lives (EngramSessionState::running_codex_tests), the holder can tell, and an explicit, recorded release exists or the holder line says plainly that Stopping the session is the only release. The release never uses a count, an age or a slot limit, which the architect ruling forbids. Every later check in that worktree is otherwise overlapped until the runtime exits.
acceptance: A design note, agreed with the TermAl architect, chooses the release (an explicit recorded action or a Codex liveness signal) or the holder wording, consistent with the no-bound ruling.
A test shows the chosen release or wording.
The full gate passes on the exact committed tree.
